title: Humoral and Cell Mediated Immunity and Safety of MF59C.1-adjuvanted Subunit Influenza Vaccine or a Conventional Subunit Influenza Vaccine in Previously Unvaccinated Healthy Subjects
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the immunogenicity, by means of cell mediated immunity (CMI) and hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assay, and also the safety of a MF59C.1-adjuvanted subunit influenza vaccine compared with a conventional subunit vaccine in previously unvaccinated children aged 6 to \<36 months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and female previously unvaccinated healthy children aged 6 to \<36 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any known or suspected impairment of the immune system, any serious disease.
* Any subjects receiving licensed vaccines within 2 weeks (for inactivated vaccines) or 4 weeks (for live vaccines) prior to enrollment in this study.
* Individuals who have had influenza vaccine or documented suspected influenza disease prior to day 1.
condition: Influenza Due to Unspecified Influenza Virus
